content.rendered:
Sherwood School District schools will be closed on Thursday, Dec. 20th through Tuesday, Jan. 1st.  SSD teachers will have a Professional Development day on Wednesday, Jan. 2nd and school offices will be open that day, but students will not have school.

School will resume for students on Thursday, Jan. 3rd to start off 2019!
